extra_vocab.en: the feeling of being very tired
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於工作時數、安全規定與健康福利的情境，指長時間工作或開車後累到無法專心，語氣比 tiredness 正式。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: fatigue 是不可數名詞，不加 a、也不加 s；常寫成 suffer from fatigue（因疲勞所苦）。

example.en: Many night shift workers suffer from fatigue after a few weeks.
example.zh: 許多夜班員工幾週後就飽受疲勞之苦。

example.en: Regular breaks can help reduce fatigue in the workplace.
example.zh: 定時休息有助於減輕職場上的疲勞。

example.en: He took sick leave because of chronic fatigue.
example.zh: 他因為長期疲勞而請了病假。

examples.en: Driver fatigue is a common cause of road accidents.
examples.zh: 駕駛疲勞是交通事故的常見原因。

examples.en: Long working hours can lead to serious fatigue.
examples.zh: 工時過長可能造成嚴重的疲勞。

examples.en: Employees who feel fatigue should take a short break.
examples.zh: 感到疲勞的員工應該稍微休息一下。

similar.diff: exhaustion 是累到極點，程度比 fatigue 更強。

example.en: The long trip left the manager in a state of exhaustion.
example.zh: 這趟長途旅行讓經理累到筋疲力盡。

similar.diff: tiredness 是日常用語，較口語；fatigue 較正式，常見於報告和公告。

example.en: Tiredness is common after a long flight across the ocean.
example.zh: 搭乘跨洋長途飛行之後常會感到疲倦。

example.en: I am tired after the long meeting this afternoon.
example.zh: 今天下午開完冗長的會議後，我覺得很累。

example.en: Please get some rest before the big presentation.
example.zh: 大型簡報之前請先好好休息。

extra_vocab.en: a boat that carries people and cars across water
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於出差、旅遊與交通公告的情境，指在固定航線來回載客與車輛的船；動詞指像渡輪一樣定期接送人或貨物。

example.en: Several ferries run between the two cities each day.
example.zh: 每天有好幾班渡輪往返這兩座城市。

example.en: The shuttle ferries guests from the airport to the hotel.
example.zh: 接駁車把賓客從機場載送到飯店。

example.en: Buses ferried the staff to the new office.
example.zh: 巴士把員工接送到新辦公室。

example.en: The boat is ferrying visitors to the island now.
example.zh: 那艘船現在正把遊客載往島上。

example.en: Passengers can take a ferry across the bay.
example.zh: 乘客可以搭渡輪橫渡海灣。

example.en: The ferry terminal is five minutes from the hotel.
example.zh: 渡輪碼頭離飯店只要五分鐘。

example.en: Please check the ferry schedule before you leave.
example.zh: 出發前請先確認渡輪時刻表。

examples.en: We took the ferry to the island for the conference.
examples.zh: 我們搭渡輪到島上參加研討會。

examples.en: The ferry service will stop during the heavy storm.
examples.zh: 渡輪服務會在暴風雨期間停駛。

examples.en: The company offers a ferry ride for visiting clients.
examples.zh: 公司為來訪客戶安排了渡輪行程。

similar.diff: boat 是通用的「船」，通常較小；ferry 是在固定航線來回載客的船。

example.en: We rented a boat for the team trip.
example.zh: 我們為團隊旅遊租了一艘船。

similar.diff: ship 指大型船隻，常用來載貨或跨海航行；ferry 是短程固定航線。

example.en: The ship carries goods to Europe every week.
example.zh: 這艘船每週把貨物運往歐洲。

example.en: The goods will arrive at the port on Monday.
example.zh: 貨物將在週一抵達港口。

example.en: Each passenger must show a ticket before boarding.
example.zh: 每位乘客登船前都必須出示票券。

example.en: The last ferry leaves the harbor at ten tonight.
example.zh: 最後一班渡輪今晚十點離開港口。

example.en: The company ferries workers between the two factories every morning.
example.zh: 公司每天早上接送員工往返兩間工廠。

extra_vocab.zh: （大學的）全體教職員；學院；能力
extra_vocab.en: the teachers and professors of a school or university
extra_vocab.note: 多益最常見的用法是指大學的教職員，常和 staff、students 一起出現在校園公告或通知中。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 指教職員這個團體時，美式英文常視為一個整體；指個人要說 a faculty member，不能說 a faculty 來表示一位老師。

example.en: Each of the university's faculties has its own budget.
example.zh: 這所大學的每個學院都有各自的預算。

example.en: Each faculty member must submit a yearly report.
example.zh: 每位教職員都必須繳交年度報告。

example.en: The faculty meeting will begin at three o'clock.
example.zh: 教職員會議將在三點開始。

example.en: Parking is free for faculty and staff on weekends.
example.zh: 週末教職員工可以免費停車。

examples.en: The university hired three new faculty members this year.
examples.zh: 這所大學今年聘了三位新教師。

examples.en: All faculty and students must carry an ID card on campus.
examples.zh: 所有教職員與學生在校園內都必須攜帶證件。

confusable.diff: 拼法很像，但 facility 是「設施、場所」，faculty 是「教職員」。
confusable.usage: facility 是可數名詞（a facility、facilities），指建築或設備；faculty 指一群教師，兩者不能互換。

example.en: The new facility has a large training room.
example.zh: 新的設施裡有一間很大的訓練室。

similar.diff: staff 泛指公司或機構的全體員工；faculty 專指學校的教師與教授。

example.en: All staff must wear a badge in the building.
example.zh: 所有員工在大樓內都必須佩戴識別證。

example.en: The professor will give a talk on trade next week.
example.zh: 那位教授下週會舉辦一場關於貿易的演講。

example.en: The bookstore is on the north side of campus.
example.zh: 書店位於校園的北側。

senses.en: all the teachers of a school or university

example.en: The faculty voted to start the new program next fall.
example.zh: 全體教職員投票決定明年秋季開始新課程。

senses.en: a main part of a university, such as law or arts
senses.distinguish: 後面接 of law、of arts 等學科名稱時，指的是學院。

example.en: She studies in the faculty of law at the university.
example.zh: 她在這所大學的法學院就讀。

senses.en: a natural ability of the body or mind
senses.distinguish: 常寫成 mental faculties，指思考與記憶等能力。

example.en: He kept all his mental faculties well into old age.
example.zh: 他到了老年仍保有全部的心智能力。

extra_vocab.en: a group of vehicles, ships, or planes owned by one company
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於運輸、物流與航空公司的情境，指公司擁有或管理的一整批車輛、船隻或飛機。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: fleet of 後面接複數名詞：a fleet of trucks、a fleet of planes。

example.en: Both fleets are being checked before the busy season.
example.zh: 兩個車隊在旺季前都在接受檢查。

example.en: The hotel has a fleet of vehicles for guests.
example.zh: 這間飯店有一批車輛供賓客使用。

example.en: Please use a company fleet car for the client visit.
example.zh: 拜訪客戶請使用公司車隊的車輛。

example.en: Good fleet management can save money on fuel.
example.zh: 良好的車隊管理可以節省燃料費用。

example.en: We plan to expand the fleet next year.
example.zh: 我們計畫明年擴充車隊。

examples.en: The company owns a fleet of fifty delivery trucks.
examples.zh: 這家公司擁有五十輛送貨卡車的車隊。

examples.en: Our fleet manager checks every vehicle each month.
examples.zh: 我們的車隊經理每個月檢查每一輛車。

examples.en: The airline plans to add ten planes to its fleet.
examples.zh: 這家航空公司計畫為機隊增加十架飛機。

confusable.diff: flight 是「一趟班機」，fleet 是「一整批車輛或飛機」。

example.en: Our flight to Tokyo leaves at seven tomorrow morning.
example.zh: 我們飛往東京的班機明天早上七點起飛。

example.en: Please park your vehicle in the lot behind the office.
example.zh: 請把你的車停在辦公室後面的停車場。

example.en: The truck will deliver the boxes this afternoon.
example.zh: 卡車今天下午會把箱子送到。

extra_vocab.en: being healthy and strong, especially from exercise
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於公司福利、健身房與健康活動的情境，指透過運動保持的體能與健康狀態；也可表示「適合某種用途」。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: fitness 是不可數名詞，不加 s，也不能說 a fitness；要說「健身中心」用 fitness center。

example.en: The hotel has a fitness center on the third floor.
example.zh: 這間飯店三樓有一間健身中心。

example.en: Good physical fitness helps you handle stressful work.
example.zh: 良好的體能能幫助你應付壓力大的工作。

example.en: I attend a fitness class after work on Tuesdays.
example.zh: 我每週二下班後會上健身課。

example.en: Our company runs a fitness program for all staff.
example.zh: 我們公司為全體員工舉辦健身計畫。

examples.en: The company gives staff a discount on gym fees to support fitness.
examples.zh: 公司提供員工健身房費用折扣，以鼓勵大家保持體能。

examples.en: Regular exercise improves your fitness and your energy at work.
examples.zh: 規律運動能提升你的體能與工作精力。

examples.en: Applicants must pass a test of physical fitness for this job.
examples.zh: 應徵者必須通過這項工作的體能測驗。

confusable.diff: 拼法和字尾很像，但 witness 是「目擊者、證人」，fitness 是「體能、健康」。

example.en: A witness described the accident to the police.
example.zh: 一位目擊者向警方描述了這起意外。

similar.diff: health 指整體身體狀況；fitness 強調透過運動維持的體能。

example.en: Regular checkups are important for your health.
example.zh: 定期健康檢查對你的健康很重要。

example.en: Daily exercise can help you feel less stressed.
example.zh: 每天運動可以讓你比較不緊張。

example.en: Many employees go to the gym during lunch.
example.zh: 許多員工午休時間會去健身房。

derived.link: 最基礎的字，fit + -ness 變成名詞，像 happy → happiness

senses.en: being strong and healthy because of exercise

example.en: She joined a gym to improve her fitness.
example.zh: 她加入健身房來提升體能。

senses.en: being good enough for a certain use or job
senses.distinguish: 後面接 for + 用途或工作時，指的是適合，不是體能。

example.en: The test shows the machine's fitness for heavy use.
example.zh: 測試顯示這台機器適合重度使用。

extra_vocab.en: a worker who is in charge of a group of workers
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於工廠、工地與施工的情境，指現場帶領工人的領班，通常向經理或工程師回報。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: foreman 的複數是不規則的 foremen，不是 foremans；重音在第一音節。

example.en: The foremen met to plan next week's work schedule.
example.zh: 領班們開會規劃下週的工作時程。

example.en: The factory foreman has worked here for twenty years.
example.zh: 那位工廠領班在這裡工作了二十年。

example.en: The site foreman will meet the inspector at nine.
example.zh: 工地領班九點會和檢查員碰面。

examples.en: The foreman checks the machines before each shift starts.
examples.zh: 領班在每個班次開始前都會檢查機器。

examples.en: Please report any safety problem to the foreman.
examples.zh: 任何安全問題請向領班回報。

examples.en: The foreman told the workers to wear helmets all day.
examples.zh: 領班要求工人整天都要戴安全帽。

similar.diff: supervisor 是各行業都能用的「主管」，較中性；foreman 多指工廠或工地的現場領班。

example.en: The supervisor approved the overtime request this morning.
example.zh: 主管今天早上核准了加班申請。

example.en: Each worker must wear a badge in the plant.
example.zh: 每位工人在廠區內都必須佩戴識別證。

example.en: The foreman reports to the plant manager every day.
example.zh: 領班每天向廠長回報。

extra_vocab.en: the right to sell a company's products or use its name
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於連鎖餐廳、零售與創業的情境，指向總公司買下使用品牌與經營方式的權利，也可指這樣的店。

example.en: The company sold franchises to owners in five countries.
example.zh: 這家公司把加盟權賣給五個國家的店主。

example.en: The brand franchised its stores across Asia last year.
example.zh: 這個品牌去年在亞洲各地開放了加盟店。

example.en: The chain is franchising its shops to small investors.
example.zh: 這家連鎖店正把店面授權給小型投資人加盟。

example.en: He saved money to open a franchise last year.
example.zh: 他去年存錢準備開一家加盟店。

example.en: New owners must pay a large franchise fee at the start.
example.zh: 新店主一開始必須支付一大筆加盟金。

example.en: Please read the franchise agreement carefully before signing.
example.zh: 簽約前請仔細閱讀加盟合約。

examples.en: She plans to open a coffee shop franchise downtown.
examples.zh: 她打算在市區開一家咖啡店加盟店。

examples.en: Franchise owners must follow the company's rules and standards.
examples.zh: 加盟店主必須遵守公司的規定與標準。

similar.diff: license 是「許可證」，範圍較廣；franchise 除了使用品牌，還包含經營方式與支援。

example.en: You need a license to sell food here.
example.zh: 你需要有許可證才能在這裡賣食物。

example.en: The coffee chain has stores in ten cities.
example.zh: 這家連鎖咖啡店在十個城市有分店。

example.en: This brand is very popular among young customers in Asia.
example.zh: 這個品牌在亞洲的年輕顧客之間非常受歡迎。

example.en: She bought the franchise for a well-known pizza brand.
example.zh: 她買下了一個知名披薩品牌的加盟權。

example.en: The firm decided to franchise its restaurants overseas.
example.zh: 這家公司決定在海外開放餐廳加盟。

senses.en: the right to use a company's name and sell its products

example.en: The franchise costs about fifty thousand dollars to buy.
example.zh: 這項加盟經營權大約要花五萬美元購買。

senses.en: a store that is run under a company's name
senses.distinguish: 前面出現 local、this 或接營業時間時，指的是一家實體加盟店。

example.en: This franchise is open every day until ten at night.
example.zh: 這間加盟店每天營業到晚上十點。

extra_vocab.en: to make someone feel upset because they cannot do something
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於客戶服務、顧客抱怨與工作效率的情境，指事情不順利讓人覺得煩躁或無力。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 「人」感到沮喪用 frustrated（I am frustrated），「事物」令人沮喪用 frustrating（The delay is frustrating），不要用反。

example.en: Every delay frustrates the customers waiting in line.
example.zh: 每一次延誤都讓排隊的顧客感到沮喪。

example.en: The long delay frustrated everyone waiting at the gate.
example.zh: 漫長的延誤讓每位在登機門等候的人都很沮喪。

example.en: Several frustrated customers called the help desk today.
example.zh: 今天有好幾位感到沮喪的顧客打電話到服務台。

example.en: Constant errors are frustrating the whole sales team.
example.zh: 不斷出現的錯誤讓整個業務團隊很沮喪。

example.en: It was a frustrating day for the support staff.
example.zh: 對客服人員來說，那是令人沮喪的一天。

example.en: Complicated forms can frustrate customers and lower sales.
example.zh: 複雜的表格可能讓顧客沮喪並降低銷售。

example.en: Budget cuts may frustrate our efforts to hire more staff.
example.zh: 預算刪減可能阻礙我們增聘人手的努力。

example.en: Many users feel frustrated when the website is slow.
example.zh: 網站很慢時，許多使用者會感到沮喪。

examples.en: Long waiting times often frustrate our customers.
examples.zh: 漫長的等待時間常讓我們的顧客感到沮喪。

examples.en: Slow replies from suppliers frustrate the whole team.
examples.zh: 供應商的回覆太慢讓整個團隊很沮喪。

examples.en: Bad weather frustrated our plans for the outdoor event.
examples.zh: 壞天氣讓我們的戶外活動計畫落空。

similar.diff: disappoint 強調結果不如預期；frustrate 強調做不到想做的事而感到煩躁。

example.en: The poor sales results disappointed the whole team.
example.zh: 糟糕的銷售結果讓整個團隊失望。

similar.diff: annoy 只是讓人覺得煩，程度比 frustrate 輕。

example.en: Loud phone calls in the office annoy many workers.
example.zh: 辦公室裡很大聲的電話讓許多員工覺得煩。

example.en: We received a complaint about the late delivery.
example.zh: 我們收到一則關於延遲送貨的客訴。

example.en: Heavy workloads cause stress for many employees.
example.zh: 繁重的工作量給許多員工帶來壓力。

derived.link: frustrate 去掉 e + -ion，把「沮喪」變成名詞，像 decorate → decoration

senses.en: to make someone feel upset or helpless

example.en: Unclear instructions frustrate new employees on their first day.
example.zh: 不清楚的指示讓新員工在第一天就感到挫折。

senses.en: to stop a plan from working
senses.distinguish: 受詞是 plans、efforts 等事物時，指的是阻撓，不是讓人沮喪。

example.en: A late shipment frustrated our plan to open on time.
example.zh: 貨物延遲讓我們準時開幕的計畫落空了。
